subject: Clarification on post-incident log storage, transfer, and deletion windows
messages:
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acme-corp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: post-incident log custody and deletion windows

Hi Marcus,

Following last week's service incident (ticket #ACME-1457), our security team has two asks so we can close our internal post-incident checklist: 1) what is Redwood's retained copy of the request/response logs for the impacted tenant and the maximum window you will keep raw forensic artifacts; and 2) what is the process and timeline to securely transfer copies to Acme (S3/secure share) and then to permanently delete Redwood-held copies after handoff?

Specifically:
- We need an auditable chain-of-custody manifest for the artifacts (who accessed, generation timestamps).
- We operate under US residency constraints for these datasets; confirm any cross-region movement.
- Desired timelines: expedited copy delivery within 72 hours, and deletion of Redwood copies within 30 days after receipt unless otherwise required for regulatory reasons.

Can you confirm what you can provide and any gaps?

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Wu
Security Operations, Acme Corp

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-incident log custody and deletion windows

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary up-front: we can provide a time-limited export of the raw request/response logs and the KV-cache snapshots for your tenant from the affected time window; we will produce a chain-of-custody manifest and transfer via a customer-controlled S3 presigned upload or a secure transfer link; Redwood can schedule deletion of our retained copies after successful transfer and verification.

Im looping Neha (security lead) and Hannah (ops) to confirm region/residency constraints and exact timelines. My suggested operational plan pending their confirmation:
- Produce manifest and package within 48 hours (attachment: forensic_manifest_v1.pdf stub).
- Provide secure transfer (S3 presigned URL or customer-provided bucket) within 72 hours.
- Hold Redwood copies in an evidence partition with restricted access for up to 30 days post-transfer; deletion executed at day 30 unless a hold is requested.

Questions for your team: will Acme accept a presigned S3 upload to a US-only bucket, or do you prefer a customer-provided, pre-configured bucket? Also confirm whether you require notarized chain-of-custody (we can coordinate with our compliance team).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: residency & deletion constraints for Acme export

Marcus, quick clarifications from security/legal:
- Residency: The affected logs for Acme are stored in our US region (us-west-2). No automated cross-region replication of raw forensic artifacts occurs for tenant-specific evidence. Any transfer we perform will be to whichever destination you specify; we can ensure the presigned URL points to a US-only bucket.
- Retention hold: By default we keep the evidence partitioned and access-logged; deletion can be performed at 30 days after verified handoff. If Acme requests a longer hold for legal reasons, we need a signed request (DocuSign) and will log the exception.
- Access audit: We will include the S3 access log and a brief access manifest (names, roles, timestamps) in forensic_manifest_v1.pdf. For chain-of-custody notarization, we do not provide external notarization by default; we can provide signatures from our incident lead and compliance officer.

Operational note for Hannah: please stage a secure export bundle (redwood-evidence-acme-brief.csv) and lock it to evidence ACL. I will coordinate the manifest content.

-Neha

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-21T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-incident log custody and deletion windows

Hi Elaine — following internal confirmation, heres the consolidated plan we can execute for Acme: 

1) Export contents (what you will receive):
- Raw request/response log slices for tenant acme-corp for the timeframe 2028-06-17 22:00 UTC to 2028-06-18 04:00 UTC.
- KV cache snapshot (applicable frames only).
- Supplemental access log and manifest (redwood-evidence-acme-brief.csv).

2) Chain-of-custody & evidence package:
- forensic_manifest_v1.pdf (attached) will include generation timestamps, SHA256 checksums for each file, and the internal access log (names/roles/timestamps).
- We will affix signatures from the Incident Lead (Neha Kapoor) and Compliance Officer.

3) Transfer method & residency: 
- Preferred: presigned S3 PUT to a US-only Acme bucket (you provide the bucket ARN and the desired object prefix).
- Alternative: secure download link from our evidence share (Drive link provided) if you cannot accept presigned uploads.
- No cross-region replication of raw artifacts will be performed by Redwood without explicit written approval from Acme.

4) Timelines: 
- Manifest and package ready: within 48 hours of this notice (target 2028-06-22T08:00:00-07:00).
- Secure transfer available: within 72 hours (target 2028-06-23T10:00:00-07:00).
- Redwood deletion of retained copies: scheduled for 30 days after successful transfer completion (we will provide a deletion certificate post-action).

5) Exceptions & holds:
- If Acme requires longer retention or a legal hold, please send a signed DocuSign request to compliance@redwood.ai and we will log an exception and extend the hold.

Attachments included: forensic_manifest_v1.pdf (manifest stub), redwood-evidence-acme-brief.csv (index). Link to staged folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-example-evidence

Please confirm preferred transfer method and provide the bucket ARN or indicate we should share a presigned URL. Once confirmed well trigger the export and send the checksums for verification.

Thanks,
Marcus
From: Elaine Wu <elaine.wu@acme-corp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2028-06-22T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: post-incident log custody and deletion windows

Marcus — thanks for the thorough plan and the manifest. We accept a presigned S3 upload to our US-only bucket (arn:aws:s3:::acme-forensics-us). Please generate the presigned PUT and send the link and checksums. We will confirm receipt and sign the DocuSign acceptance for the 30-day deletion schedule.

Elaine
